verdict.rationale: Trilegal says it runs one of India's largest dedicated Asset Management and Funds teams, covering private equity and venture capital fund structuring. It also represents major investors such as Blackstone, KKR, Carlyle and Prosus across deployment and exits, and it works with promoters, entrepreneurs and emerging tech businesses on the company side, so it sits on both sides of the table. Missing for 10: specific venture-round deal examples on the investor side (the evidence is mostly private equity), any explicit evidence of insight into current venture market terms, and independent corroboration beyond the firm's own pages and rankings it cites.
